settings.label: Hide sold-out values
settings.info: A value stays visible while it is selected, so a shopper arriving on a sold-out variant still sees what they picked.

settings.label: Show colour swatches
settings.info: Uses the swatches set on your product options in Shopify, then the fallback list in Theme settings > Colour swatches. Values without either stay text pills.

settings.label: Size chart option
settings.info: Option name, for example Size. A size chart link appears next to it when this section also has a Size chart block with a page or image.

settings.content: Add Offer card blocks to write each card's label, caption, badge and benefit line. Without them, one card per option value is generated.

settings.label: Option shown as cards
settings.info: The product's other options appear as pills under the cards. Falls back to the first option when a product has fewer options.

settings.label: Card selected on load
settings.info: 0 opens on the first available variant. A sold-out card is never preselected, and a link that names a variant (?variant=) always wins.

settings.label: Savings on cards
settings.info: Computed from each variant's compare-at price, and shown only when it is higher than the price. Enter a compare-at price only if the item really sold at it; there is no manual savings field.
